customFields.title: Custom Fields
customFields.description: Manage your custom fields and configurations

packs.title: Gacha Packs
packs.subtitle: Create and manage gacha packs — listing details, status, and prize pools. Open a pack to edit its prize pool and win rates.

defaults.title: Default odds
defaults.floored: {{tiers}}: more cards than the share allows, so each sits at the {{min}} floor and the tier costs more than its share.
defaults.zeroed: {{tiers}}: share is 0%, so those cards can never be pulled.
defaults.overspent: {{tiers}}: locked rates already exceed the share, so the tier costs more than its number says.
defaults.noBalancer: No unlocked Common to absorb the remainder — set one card to Common and leave it unlocked.

published.title: Published odds (public)
published.subtitle: What players see on the pack page. Display-only — independent of the real win rates below.
published.notSet: Not set yet — the storefront hides the odds panel for this pack until you save.

form.subtitle: Sets the pack's storefront listing. A new pack starts with an empty prize pool — open it afterwards to add cards.
form.displayImageHint: Optional wide scene shown only in the pack page's hero stage — recommended 2560×1778 (36:25 landscape; 16:9 works, edges crop). Animated WebP/GIF allowed. Leave empty to show the pack image instead. This never replaces the pack image on tiles or the catalog.
form.slugHint: Unique, lowercase, kebab-case. Permanent — it keys the pack and its /claw URL.
form.buybackHint: "Sell on the spot" rate during the 30s keep/sell countdown at the reveal: this % of the card's market value as site credit. Must be at least the flat rate (90) — vaulted cards always sell back at flat 90%.
form.boostHint: Flags the pack as boosted/featured on the storefront.
form.poolHint: After creating, open the pack to add cards to its prize pool.
form.statusCreateHint: New packs start as drafts. Add cards to the prize pool on the pack page, then activate.

delete.title: Delete pack?
delete.description: This permanently removes "{{title}}" and its prize-pool membership. Cards and past pulls are kept. This cannot be undone.

pool.title: Prize pool
pool.subtitle: Pick the cards in this pack. {{count}} selected. New cards join as Common; with Tier Defaults configured, their tier is pre-staged below — review the rarity and win rates, then save.
pool.loadError: Could not load the card catalog.
pool.noCards: No cards registered yet. Register inventory products as gacha cards first.
pool.outsideTitle: Card value outside every tier range
pool.outsideDesc_one: {{count}} of the cards you are adding falls outside every configured tier price range (see Tier Defaults). It will join as Common. Add it anyway?
pool.outsideDesc_other: {{count}} of the cards you are adding fall outside every configured tier price range (see Tier Defaults). They will join as Common. Add them anyway?

tierRanges.title: Tier price ranges
tierRanges.inheritNote: Inheriting the global Tier Defaults ladder.
tierRanges.overrideNote: Pack-specific ranges — this pack ignores the global Tier Defaults.
tierRanges.hint: Blank = open on that side; both blank = tier unconfigured. Overlaps resolve to the rarest match.
tierRanges.badNumber: {{tier}}: bounds must be numbers between 0 and 100,000,000.

editor.title: Win rates
editor.subtitle: Set each card's rarity for this pack. Unlocked cards follow the default odds above; lock one to type its own rate. Secret — customers never see these.
editor.unpullable: Below 0.01% — this saves as a 0 weight, so the card can never be pulled. Use 0.01 or more.
editor.activated: Pack activated — it is now live on the storefront.
editor.deactivated: Pack set to draft — hidden from the storefront.
editor.activateNeedsPool: Add at least one card to the prize pool first.
editor.draftBanner: Draft — hidden from the storefront. Add cards to the prize pool, save win rates, then activate.
editor.draftReadyBanner: Draft — hidden from the storefront. The prize pool has cards; activate when the win rates look right.
editor.pendingRow: new — not in pool until saved
editor.outOfRangeHint: Value {{value}} is outside the configured {{tier}} price range (Tier Defaults). The tier never switches on its own — retier manually if needed.
editor.driftAlert_one: {{count}} card's market value is outside its tier's configured price range (see the orange badges). Tiers never switch automatically — review and retier manually if needed.
editor.driftAlert_other: {{count}} cards' market values are outside their tiers' configured price ranges (see the orange badges). Tiers never switch automatically — review and retier manually if needed.

bulk.removeDesc_one: Remove {{count}} card from this pack's prize pool? Its saved win rate is deleted, but the card stays in the catalog and in other packs.
bulk.removeDesc_other: Remove {{count}} cards from this pack's prize pool? Their saved win rates are deleted, but the cards stay in the catalog and in other packs.

tierDefaults.title: Tier Defaults
tierDefaults.subtitle: Value range per rarity tier (RM display price — FMV × FX × markup). When a card joins a pack's prize pool its rarity defaults to the tier whose range holds its value; a card outside every range asks for confirmation before it is added. The odds editor flags cards whose price has drifted out of their tier, but never re-tiers them automatically.
tierDefaults.hint: Blank = open on that side. Leave both blank to leave a tier out of auto-assignment. Overlapping tiers resolve to the rarest match; a value covered by no tier prompts "add anyway?".

errors.number: {{tier}}: {{side}} must be a number between 0 and 100,000,000.

pcAdd.title: Add from PriceCharting
pcAdd.subtitle: Search PriceCharting, pick a graded tier, and queue a marketplace product carrying that live-price link. Queue as many cards as you like, then save the whole batch in one pass. Cards registered from these products auto-track their value daily.

grade.label: Grade tier
grade.loadError: Could not load prices for this product.
grade.empty: No prices available for this product.
grade.fxHint: Prices shown in RM at the live FX rate — no markup applied. Margin is set when the card is registered for gacha.

stock.label: Stock quantity
stock.hint: Physical copies you hold. Decrements as the card is pulled or sold. Default 0 — count units when the slabs are in hand.

image.label: Image
image.hint: Auto-filled from the PriceCharting card photo when a match is picked. Paste a different PriceCharting image URL or upload your own to override. A PriceCharting URL is fetched and stored through the media pipeline on save — never hotlinked.
image.autoFilled: Will be fetched & stored on save

pixel.required: Required — the reel can't render this card without a pixel sprite. Link a library entry or upload one above.

pcCollection.title: Add from PriceCharting collection
pcCollection.subtitle: Scan your own PriceCharting collection and onboard many holdings in one pass. It runs to thousands of items, so the scan pages through with live counters and can be stopped as soon as what you want is on screen. Importing re-reads each pick at its live per-grade value (not the collection valuation); you then set units held and link a pixel Pokémon before saving the batch.
pcCollection.empty: No holdings came back from PriceCharting.
pcCollection.filter: Filter by name, set or grade tag…
pcCollection.valueHint: Value shown is PriceCharting's valuation of your holding, for triage only. Import re-reads the live per-grade price so it matches what the nightly sync writes.
pcCollection.noGrader: no grader (tier is a price comp)

skip.noImage: {{name}}: PriceCharting has no card photo — add it on the search page.
skip.noPrices: {{name}}: PriceCharting lists no prices for this product.

toast.imported: {{n}} imported — set units and pixel Pokémon, then save.

pcCollection.rowCap: Showing the first {{shown}} of {{total}} matches — narrow the filter to reach the rest.
pcCollection.merged: {{n}} holdings of this card at this grade — one product. Units import as 0; set them to list it.
pcCollection.foreignDropped: {{n}} rows were not yours and were dropped — PRICECHARTING_SELLER_ID does not match the account the API token reads.

cards.title: Gacha Cards
cards.subtitle: Inventory products registered as gacha prizes. Add the item to the product catalog first, then register it here; rarity is chosen per pack in each pack's win-rate editor.

list.empty: No cards registered yet. Add one from the inventory to get started.

bulk.pickSubtitle: Pick the pack to add {{count}} card(s) to. They are staged in that pack's win-rate editor — nothing is saved until you save there.
bulk.noPacks: No packs yet — create a pack first.
bulk.packsError: Could not load the packs list.
bulk.outsideTitle: Card value outside every tier range
bulk.outsideDesc_one: {{count}} of the selected cards falls outside every configured tier price range (see Tier Defaults). It will be staged as Common. Add it anyway?
bulk.outsideDesc_other: {{count}} of the selected cards fall outside every configured tier price range (see Tier Defaults). They will be staged as Common. Add them anyway?

register.title: Add card from inventory
register.subtitle: Pick an existing inventory product and add the gacha facts. Name, image, and handle come from the product — create the product first if it is not listed.
register.noEligible: Every inventory product is already registered. Create a new product in the catalog first.
register.pcNoMatches: No PriceCharting matches — refine the search or enter the value manually.
register.pcNoPrices: No prices recorded for this product — enter the value manually.
register.pcHint: Pick a match, then click a grade price to fill the market value. Needs PRICECHARTING_API_TOKEN on the backend; manual entry always works.
register.autofillHint: Set, grade, grader and fair-market value were auto-filled from the product — adjust if needed.
register.rarityHint: Rarity is NOT set here — the same card can be a different tier per pack. Choose it when you add the card to a pack (Gacha Packs → pool & odds).

form.subtitle: Edits the gacha facts and the marketplace listing mirror (price + visibility).
form.uploadHint: Upload a file, or paste a storefront-relative path (e.g. /cdn/cards/x.webp).
form.name: Name
form.labelHint: Printed on the slab label. Blank renders nothing.
form.forSaleHint: When off, the card stays a pack prize but is hidden from the store.
form.markupHint: Display-only markup applied on top of the tracked PriceCharting value. 20 = show 20% above FMV.

toast.unlinked: Card unlinked from PriceCharting — now priced manually.
toast.deleted: Card removed from the gacha system.

delete.title: Remove card?
delete.description: This removes "{{name}}" from the gacha system and from every pack's prize pool. The inventory product and past pulls are kept. This cannot be undone.

deposits.title: Deposits
deposits.subtitle: GlobePay365 top-ups — what a customer started paying, and what actually settled.
deposits.staleWarning: {{n}} row(s) on this page are past the reconcile window. Check the deposit in the GlobePay back office before crediting anyone by hand.

withdrawals.title: Withdrawals
withdrawals.subtitle: GlobePay365 payouts — money already debited from a customer, and whether the bank transfer settled or refunded.
withdrawals.staleWarning: {{n}} row(s) on this page are past the reconcile window — the customer is debited with no payout confirmed. Check the withdrawal in the GlobePay back office before touching anything by hand.
withdrawals.emptyView: No {{view}} withdrawals right now. Other statuses may still have rows.
withdrawals.emptyAll: No withdrawals have been requested yet.
withdrawals.emptyPage: Nothing on this page. This view has {{total}} withdrawal(s).

pulls.title: Pull Ledger
pulls.subtitle: Every pack opened, the card won, and who pulled it.
pulls.loadError: Could not load the pull ledger.

support.title: Customer Support
support.subtitle: Look up a customer's credits, pulls, and vault — and apply credit adjustments.
support.fxNotFirm: FX rate unavailable — customer sell-backs are currently refused; quotes below are indicative only.
support.adjustInvalid: Amount must be a number (e.g. 5 or -5).
support.adjustConfirmDescription: This will apply {{amount}} to {{email}}'s credit balance. The note is recorded in the ledger.

customer360.title: Customer 360
customer360.treeSubtitle: Direct recruits and their downline — up to 6 levels deep.
customer360.treeTruncated: Tree exceeds 1 000 nodes — showing the first 1 000. Open a subtree to explore deeper.
customer360.commissionsSubtitle: All commissions earned by this customer as a referral sponsor.
customer360.auditSubtitle: All freeze, unfreeze, credit adjustment, and commission actions on this account.
customer360.modalReasonPlaceholder: Required — recorded in the audit trail
customer360.modalFreezeDesc: The customer will be locked out. Enter a reason for the audit trail.
customer360.modalUnfreezeDesc: The customer will regain access. Enter a reason for the audit trail.
customer360.modalCreditsDesc: Apply a credit adjustment to this customer's balance. Amount and note are required.
customer360.modalReverseDesc: This permanently reverses the commission. Enter a reason for the audit trail.
customer360.modalSuspendDesc: The commission will be held. Enter a reason for the audit trail.
customer360.modalUnsuspendDesc: The commission will be released back to available. Enter a reason for the audit trail.

economy.title: Economy
economy.subtitle: Lifetime credit flows and what the vault still owes.
economy.rtpSubtitle: Expected payout per open from the current odds × card display values (FMV × markup, default +20%) — the value buyback rates apply to. Above 100% means the pack loses money.
economy.loadError: Could not load the economy report.

pipeline.label: Inventory pipeline
pipeline.pack: Add to a pack & set win rates

players.title: All Players
players.subtitle: Every registered player, their wallet, vault and turnover.
players.name: Name
players.disableDesc: They will be signed out and blocked from logging in. Their credits and vault are untouched.
players.enableDesc: They will be able to log in again.
players.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this happening? (recorded in the audit log)
players.bankSubtitle: Where withdrawals are paid out. Changes are recorded in the audit trail.
players.noLevel: This player has no VIP level yet.
players.groupSubtitle: The group decides which odds set this player rolls on. A player is in exactly one group.
players.groupDuplicated: This player is in {{count}} groups. Saving puts them in the one shown and clears the rest.
players.groupUnassigned: Not stored in a group yet — DEFAULT is the odds set they already roll. Save to record it.

oddsSets.title: Odds Sets
oddsSets.subtitle: Player groups are customer groups. Each one plays one odds set — set 2 falls back to set 1 and set 3 to set 2, per card. New sign-ups land in DEFAULT, which is locked to set 1 so its members roll exactly like a player with no group. Change a player's group on their own profile page.
oddsSets.duplicate: That name is taken or reserved.
oddsSets.empty: No customer groups yet. Create one above, or manage them on the Customer Groups page.

ledger.title: Transactions
ledger.subtitle: Every wallet and vault event, read-only.
ledger.searchPlaceholder: Search transaction id or player email

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.pageSubtitle: Every catalog item — registered gacha cards and items not yet promoted.
inventory.name: Name
inventory.skipNoFmv: no FMV recorded — set one on the product first
